changelog:
Initial release with cross-platform desktop notification support:

- Sends native notifications on Windows, macOS, Linux, and WSL.
- Uses a single shell script (`notify.sh`) to auto-detect the OS and trigger appropriate alerts.
- Supports custom message and title for each notification.
- Documentation includes usage guidelines and practical examples.
summary: Triggers native system notifications across Windows, macOS, and Linux (including WSL) to alert the user when tasks are complete.
